title: Discipline Foundation
description: Build self-discipline through consistent habits and mental training

goals.title: Build Consistency
goals.description: Complete your daily habits for 21 consecutive days

goals.title: Overcome Procrastination
goals.description: Start tasks within 5 minutes of planning them

habits.title: Wake Up On Time
habits.description: Wake up at your set time without snooze

habits.title: Do Hard Thing First
habits.description: Complete your most difficult task first

habits.title: No Excuses
habits.description: Complete planned tasks regardless of mood

habits.title: Reflect on Discipline
habits.description: Review your discipline and identify improvements

tasks.title: Identify Weaknesses
tasks.description: List areas where you lack discipline

tasks.title: Create Accountability System
tasks.description: Set up ways to hold yourself accountable

tasks.title: Remove Temptations
tasks.description: Identify and remove distractions from your environment

tasks.title: Practice Discomfort
tasks.description: Do one uncomfortable thing daily to build resilience

warnings: Discipline is a muscle that builds over time
Don't be too hard on yourself when you slip
Start small and gradually increase difficulty
fallback_message: I found a great discipline template! Let me help you build self-discipline through consistent habits.
